issues.where: shadowed outer bracts and folded inner petals across the flower bud (also set-C-02.png crops 1, 2, 4)
issues.what: dark bracts in deep shadow have bright white jagged sawtooth outlines where no rim light can reach, and the unopened inner petals are smooth plastic-like straps that crisscross and interpenetrate across the face of the bud
issues.fix: replace the unlit white bract-edge outline with properly shadowed fine marginal hairs that only brighten in direct rim light, and model layered imbricated inner petals and bracts with collision instead of intersecting flat ribbons

issues.where: foreground neighbor leaves at the bottom-left edge (also set-C-01.png, set-C-03.png crop 7, and set-C-06.png crop 7)
issues.what: the shadowed neighbor leaves read as flat, single-tone slate-blue waxy cards with crude, sharp geometric V-shaped sawtooth cutouts and zero lamina thickness
issues.fix: give the foreground neighbor leaves organic serrated margins, physical leaf thickness, fine surface trichomes, and natural shadow color variation

issues.where: ray petals and bract bases around the flower head in crops 1, 2, 4 (also set-C-02.png crops 1, 2 and set-C-06.png crop 11)
issues.what: petals have smooth waxy surfaces with heavy painted-on brown stripes, razor-sharp 1-pixel dark outlines along backlit edges, angular low-poly bract facets visible between petal bases, and a stray bright floret fragment sitting on the lower-left backlit petal at 8 o'clock
issues.fix: subdivide petal and bract geometry, remove the dark 1-pixel edge outline, replace painted stripes with subtle displaced venation and velvety cellular micro-roughness, and remove the stray floret geometry on the petal

issues.where: hero plant leaves and petiole-to-stem junctions in crops 3, 4, 5 (also set-C-05.png crops 3, 4, 5, 6 and set-C-06.png crop 8)
issues.what: backlit leaves show blurry opaque dark-painted vein bands instead of raised translucent veins; the curled right leaf has hard polygonal creases, paper-thin edges, beaded rim-pixel aliasing, and loses its arching stem petiole at 50.5 s; and lower petioles meet the stem in straight unblended cuts with no clasping node
issues.fix: model raised vein geometry with realistic subsurface scattering, subdivide leaf meshes to remove polygonal folds and rim aliasing, blend petioles into swollen stem nodes, and keep the upper-right leaf petiole consistently attached across frames

issues.where: out-of-focus midground leaves and background flower heads in crops 7, 8, 9 (also set-C-03.png crop 7 and set-C-05.png crop 5)
issues.what: blurred midground leaves on the left have pale glowing halo rings around flat dark-green centers, and background sunflowers read as repeated round yellow rings with overly dark black centers facing away from the sun even inside bright golden haze
issues.fix: render true optical depth of field without Z-defocus edge halos, vary background flower head shapes and orientations toward the sun, and apply realistic atmospheric veil over distant dark disc centers

issues.where: sky extending rightward from the sun below the cloud deck in crop 10 (also set-C-06.png crop 10, set-C-01.png, and set-C-04.png)
issues.what: a sharp, ruler-straight horizontal brightness step cuts across the sky from the sun toward the flower head, exposing an unfeathered horizontal lens-flare or glow-strip boundary
issues.fix: feather the vertical falloff and expand the bounds of the horizontal sun-flare element so no straight horizontal edge is visible in the sky gradient

issues.where: central unopened disc florets in crops 1 and 2
issues.what: the inner disc center is composed of overly uniform, smooth green bead-like spheres with an abrupt transition to the outer ring of open florets
issues.fix: add fine star-tipped tubular bud geometry, subtle fuzz, and a gradual opening transition from inner disc buds to outer florets
